candidate.answerReason: Random selection with an appropriate sample size can reasonably reflect the population. Increasing sample size alone does not remove selection bias, and selecting only acquaintances can introduce bias.

methods.label: Representativeness and selection bias
methods.explanation: Representativeness depends on whether the selection method is random and whether the sample size is appropriate. When the sampling method is biased, even a large number of people does not necessarily make the sample representative.
methods.levelReason: This uses Grade 7 ideas about random sampling, sample size, and selection bias.
